mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending supply-side slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates insufficient consumer spending to sustain economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during post-pandemic recovery when RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a monetary tightening cycle combined with labor market weakness, which reduces corporate earnings growth and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
